title: Cloudflare's new AI traffic options for customers
summary: Cloudflare announced new AI traffic management options that give website owners enhanced control over how AI bots and crawlers access their content, including features for identifying, blocking, or selectively allowing AI traffic.
problem_solved: Provides website owners with granular control over AI crawler traffic to protect content and manage server resources.
why_valuable: As AI crawlers increasingly consume web content, this gives publishers the ability to monetize, restrict, or monitor AI access to their sites.
